bottleneck.description: Tier-1 supplier of VSAT ground-segment platforms (SkyEdge IV/II-c) and electronically steered antennas for LEO/multi-orbit networks; Gogo exclusive ESA antenna provider for Galileo business aviation and a key OneWeb/Eutelsat LEO ground partner.

dependency.key_customers: Gogo (exclusive ESA antenna distribution for bizav/defense), Eutelsat OneWeb, US DoD (Satellite Transportable Terminals, CCT-series portable terminals via Gilat DataPath/Defense), satellite operators (Intelsat, SES, Telesat), telecom operators using VSAT backhaul.
dependency.key_suppliers: RF/MMIC component vendors, antenna phase-shifter ICs, contract manufacturers for hubs/modems, Israeli aerospace supply base.

editorial.notes: Gilat occupies a defensible niche in ground-segment hubs, modems, and increasingly LEO-capable ESAs, where it competes with Hughes, Viasat, ST Engineering iDirect, and Comtech — a clear oligopoly, not a monopoly. The exclusive Gogo Galileo ESA arrangement and growing DoD portable-terminal business create switching friction (qualification, certifications), justifying MEDIUM rather than LOW. Not CRITICAL or HIGH because multiple credible substitutes exist for VSAT hubs and ESAs.
